header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Aziz Ahmed Laghari advocate for the petitioners.
Mr. Ghulamullah Memon, A.A.G a/w Mr. Awais Mirza,
body: After arguing the matter at some length, learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he is only grievance that proper water for irrigating land be provided to the petitioners as per share list of Khatedars from the concerned water courses/R.D. The Executive Engineer, Jamrao Division, Mirpurkhas, present in court, undertakes that as per share list all the khatedars will be provided water for irrigating their lands.
In view of above position, instant Petition alongwith listed pending application stands disposed of accordingly. JUDGE JUDGE “Saleem”
